item.description: Structure Fire [Now Out]; INC#0743; 08:49AM; 7930 N Whitsett Av; MAP: <a href="https://bit.ly/4ijuk7j" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://bit.ly/4ijuk7j</a>; Sun Valley; First arriving fire companies reported a 1 story single family dwelling with fire showing from one room. Fire fighters operated in the offensive mode. The Incident Commander declared a knockdown of the fire at 0910 hours. Fire fighters extinguished the fire within 21 minutes from the time of the 911 call. One adult male was medically treated on scene and at the time of this 'public alert', has not been transported. The cause of the fire is undetermined at this time. Animal services notified for unattended domestic animals on site. Department of Transportation was notified and the LAPD was notified (LAPD Incident# 1516). Nothing further.; FS 89; Batt 14; Valley Bureau; Council District 2; BC10 BC14 E260 E278 E289 E298 E39 E89 EM14 HM87 JT3 RA77 RA889 SO1 T60 T78 T89 T98; CH8; 14; Jamie Stewart
